name: AK25A - Mini Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, Temperature, Humidity), 98g Portable
highlights: The Smallest Multi-Parameter Body We Build — 66.3 × 30.6 × 96 mm and 98 g — under half the weight of the AK3 — with the same five readings. Nothing in the range packs this much sensing into this little space.
Five Readings, No Coverage Traded Away — CO₂, TVOC and formaldehyde with temperature and humidity, each with its own colour status band.
Fits Where a Desktop Unit Will Not — Hotel nightstands, a shelf in a nursery, a car cup holder, the outside pocket of a laptop bag.
1200 mAh, Six Hours — Roughly four hours to charge over USB-C.
Lowest Freight Weight in the Range — 98 g per unit — the cheapest multi-parameter monitor to air-freight, which matters when a first order goes by courier.
